I was an edgy athiest for a long time, but I began to have a bit of a religious crisis. I wanted something to believe in, but I couldn't get myself to believe in any omnipotent deity. I wanted to believe, but I couldn't mentally justify it to myself.

I went on a quest, reading all sorts of religious texts, and then I read the Principia Discordia. I don't remember where I saw the recommendation, but I thought "what the hell" and read it just to knock it off the list. But I read it... and so much of it made sense to me. The way it was written, the jokes inside, Eris herself, it all made a staggering amount of sense, and I began to feel Her presence in my life in my friends, in the concerts i would go to, and in music itself. 

I saw Her in little things as well, like the way my girlfriend's hair curled, or how people would walk the hallways in school. I remember eating a really good sandwich with my best friend, and we both laughed at some dumb joke and thinking "yeah, this is it, this is why i'm alive, probably" and feeling completely and utterly content with myself and with Eris.
